post_v1_protocol.name: orvix-owner-authorization-v1 / recovery_v1.apply_authorized_migration
post_v1_protocol.rule: after RECOVERY_V1 a schema change runs only inside apply_authorized_migration: the owner signs (RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 SHA-256, offline key) an authorization naming the purpose 'migration', the exact SQL sha256, the target (database, system identifier, V1 install time), the current chain head, the allowed DDL commands and the new tables, with a short expiry and a single-use nonce. Unknown checksums, a wrong predecessor, a wrong target, an expired or replayed authorization, or any DDL outside the list are refused before anything runs; an interruption rolls the whole transaction back (the log records the step reached). New tables need org_id and row-level security and are guarded automatically. A compromised server cannot mint an authorization (it holds only the public key).
